title: Agente04_DevBackend Handoff Package
description: Schema for the Handoff Package produced by Agente04_DevBackend and delivered to Agente06_QaEngineer for Gate 4 (QA Review).

artifact_produced.description: Primary artifact produced by this implementation cycle.

summary.description: High-level description of what was implemented — which task, which files, which patterns used.

tasks_completed.description: List of atomic tasks completed in this handoff cycle.

task_id.description: Task identifier from the Execution Plan.

file_path.description: Primary file created or modified for this task.

implementation_summary.description: Brief description of what was implemented for this task.

assumptions.description: Assumptions made during implementation that are not explicitly stated in the task spec or API contract.

impact.description: What breaks or changes if this assumption is wrong.

open_questions.description: Unresolved questions that may affect the QA review or subsequent work.

blocking.description: If true, this question blocks Gate 4 from being approved — must be resolved before submission.

description.description: What the risk is and what could go wrong.

mitigation.description: How the risk is mitigated or what action is needed.

blocks_gate.description: CRITICAL risks without mitigation block Gate 4.

required_next_agent.description: Always Agente06_QaEngineer — the QA Engineer evaluates Gate 4.

validation_checklist.description: Self-review checklist items — each must be confirmed before gate_ready: true.
examples: Zod validation at all input boundaries
Auth check first in all Server Actions and Route Handlers
DAL used for all DB access
Error handling catches internally — no stack traces to client
Test files created with minimum 4 test cases per function
audit_log added for all sensitive human actions
sync_log in finally block for all cron routes
guardCron() is first call in all cron routes
prisma migrate dev used (not prisma db push)

implementation_summary.description: Quantitative summary of what was implemented.

files_created.description: Number of new TypeScript files created.

zod_schemas_added.description: Number of Zod schema definitions added.

gate_ready.description: True only when all self-review checklist items are confirmed and there are no blocking open questions or CRITICAL unmitigated risks.
